android.desc:
The best audiobooks experience Android has to offer. 

Link your Plex library and listen to all your audiobooks on any device (including Android Auto). Get access to all of the advanced features exclusive to Bookcamp.

Rediscover the joy of listening to audiobooks.

EXPLORE YOUR LIBRARY

Browse by name, release date, author, collection, or your reading list.

OFFLINE? NO PROBLEM

Download your favorite audiobooks for offline listening. Save data, enjoy anywhere, anytime.

SPEED CONTROL, VOICE BOOST AND SLEEP TIMER

Read at extra speed without distortion, even in noisy places. Without blowing your ears out.

SYNC ACROSS DEVICES

Every action you take while listening to a book is synced across all your devices. Tap an entry and go back in time.

You may purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase, which is required to use Bookcamp.

- Bookcamp Premium, Bookcamp Hero, and Legend are available as 1-year or 1-month renewable subscriptions.
- Payment will be charged to your Play Store account at purchase.
- Auto-renewable subscriptions will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the initial period subscription, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

quotes.text:
1500$ MRR (or ~1000$ after taxes and operating costs) with a (native) Plex audiobook player for iOS and Android.

Android accounts for 85% of the userbase and has been the focus last year with a 2.0 release so it's in much better shape than the iOS version, which is still in 1.0 today. MRR is growing 5-10% per month, not sure how big the niche is yet. It's a lot of efforts to maintain both platforms as native apps with a high level of quality, but trully convinced crossplatform solution are not worth it either.

-> https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.bookcamp.android
